sloka: तद्वानरानीकमतिप्रचण्डं दिशो द्रवद्भिन्नमिवाभ्रजालम्।स कुम्भकर्णः समवेक्ष्य हर्षान्ननाद भूयो घनवद् घनाभः ।। ६.६५.५६ ।।
transliteration: tadvānarānīkamatipracaṇḍaṁ diśo dravadbhinnamivābhrajālam।sa kumbhakarṇaḥ samavekṣya harṣānnanāda bhūyo ghanavad ghanābhaḥ ।। 6.65.56 ।।

translations.english: Hearing the dreadful roar of Kumbhakarna, that resembled the rumbling of clouds, many Vanaras fell on the ground like severed Sala trees.
